mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% and 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 5% signals a tightening labor market, which increases corporate costs and reduces profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE < 5% and 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals increased consumer demand and economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST increases and 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% MoM signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO MoM < -1% and 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and the GDP (GDPC1) growth rate is below 2% YoY, it signals a restrictive monetary policy in a slowing economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: restrictive monetary policy in a slowing economy
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS > 2% and GDPC1 YoY < 2%, and 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 jobs signals strong labor market conditions, which can lead to wage inflation and tighter monetary policy, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS MoM > 200,000 and 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) grow by more than 5% YoY and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 6%, it signals robust consumer demand in a healthy labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: robust consumer demand in a healthy labor market
failure_condition: If RSAFS YoY > 5% and UNRATE < 6%, and 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below its 12-month moving average signals a supply-side recession, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO < 12-month MA and 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the triggered instances.
